name: desktop-statusline
description: Claude desktop app only. A usage bar above the prompt with context, 5-hour and 7-day limits, a prompt cache countdown with a keep-warm button and the session cost at API prices.

subscriptionUsd.title: Monthly subscription (USD)
subscriptionUsd.description: What your Claude plan costs a month. The Eq. API bar is full at 1x this, light blue from 2x and gold from 5x.

inputPrices.title: Input price overrides
inputPrices.description: Only if Anthropic's prices change: part of a model id = input USD per million tokens, comma-separated, e.g. opus-5-5=4, sonnet-5-5=2. Empty uses the built-in prices.
